data.summary: After Friday's market close, BofA Securities senior insurance analyst Joshua Shanker sits down with Jared Blikre to discuss his investment outlook on the broader insurance landscape for 2026, going into detail about how the Federal Reserve's interest rate adjustments feed into insurance companies' "float" — or the money these companies hold between collecting premiums and paying out policy claims. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
